name: Craig Jones Leg Lock System
description: Craig Jones’s Down Under Leg Attacks covers single-leg X, saddle, 50/50, escape-response topics and back-taking branches.
summary: Heel-hook offense across single-leg X, saddle and 50/50, with escape responses and back takes.
overview: Down Under Leg Attacks covers Craig Jones’s entries and attacks across several leg entanglements. Heel exposure and finishing sit alongside common escape responses, while back takes provide another direction from leg-control positions. Its four volumes also connect leg attacks to existing submissions and guard entries.

products.title: Down Under Leg Attacks
products.blurb: Four volumes combining leg-entanglement entries, heel hooks, escape responses and back takes.
products.best_for: Grapplers looking for leg-lock offense with positional follow-ups.

guide.display_title: Craig Jones: Down Under Leg Attacks

fits: You want heel-hook material across several entanglements.
You want escape-response and back-taking coverage alongside leg-lock finishes.

includes: Single-leg X, saddle and 50/50 positioning and attacks.
Heel exposure, finishing and responses to running or kick-off escapes.
Back takes and leg entries connected to guillotines, kimuras and guard positions.
limits: The course emphasizes heel-hook offense and its positional connections; it is not an equal survey of every foot, ankle and knee submission.
